Privacy information for this site

Cookies

This site doesn't set cookies and doesn't store anything on your device to measure visits. The only exception is if you use the button below to turn analytics off: your browser then remembers that choice.

Visitor statistics

We use GoatCounter, a privacy-friendly analytics service, to count visits so we can see which pages help people and improve the site. It doesn't use cookies and doesn't build a profile of you. For each page view it records:

  • the page address and title, and the website that sent you here (for example a search engine)
  • your browser and operating system type, screen size, and country or region (worked out from your IP address)
  • a random visit ID so a reload isn't counted twice. Your IP address and full browser details are only held in the service's memory, for up to 8 hours, to create this ID. They are never saved

We also count a few actions on our pages:

  • when you click a link to another website, such as a software provider's "Visit" button: which product or website, and which of our pages you clicked from
  • which "Start here" button you press (for example "I'm a landlord")
  • which comparison filters you switch on. If you type in the search box we only record that a search was used, never what you typed
  • roughly how long a page was open and in use (in seconds)

Visitor statistics never include your name, email or anything you type. We only look at the results as totals, such as "120 visits to this page", and we don't use them for advertising or to identify anyone. GoatCounter processes the data on our behalf.

Our lawful basis is legitimate interests: understanding how the site is used so we can improve it. You can object at any time:

We also don't count visits if your browser sends a "Do Not Track" or "Global Privacy Control" signal.

Email sign-up

Our automatic Free MTD Ready Kit sign-up isn't switched on yet, so we don't run a mailing list and the site doesn't collect any names or email addresses. If you email us to ask for the kit, we use your email address and anything you write only to reply to you. We don't add you to a list. Before automatic sign-up opens, this section will explain exactly what we collect and why.

Other websites

When you click through to a software provider, their own privacy policy applies. If a link is an affiliate link, the provider may use its own cookies to record that you came from us. See our affiliate disclosure.

Your rights and contact

You can ask us for a copy of your data, or to correct or delete it, and you can complain to the Information Commissioner's Office.
